```yamlfile
name: CI

on: [push, pull_request]

env:
  DEVELOPER: 1

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.sha }}

jobs:
  dockerized:
    name: linux-meson (ubuntu:rolling)
    needs: ci-config
    if: needs.ci-config.outputs.enabled == 'yes'
    concurrency:
      group: dockerized-linux-meson-ubuntu:rolling-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ needs.ci-config.outputs.skip_concurrent == 'yes' }}
    env:
      jobname: linux-meson
      CC: gcc
      CI_JOB_IMAGE: ubuntu:rolling
      CUSTOM_PATH: /custom
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: ubuntu:rolling
    steps:
    - name: install git in container
      run: |
        if command -v git
        then
          : # nothing to do
        elif command -v apk
        then
          apk add --update git
        elif command -v dnf
        then
          dnf -yq update && dnf -yq install git
        else
          apt-get -q update && apt-get -q -y install git
        fi
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5
    - run: ci/install-dependencies.sh
    - run: useradd builder --create-home
    - run: chown -R builder .
    - run: chmod a+w $GITHUB_ENV && sudo --preserve-env --set-home --user=builder ci/run-build-and-tests.sh
    - name: print test failures
      if: failure() && env.FAILED_TEST_ARTIFACTS != ''
      run: sudo --preserve-env --set-home --user=builder ci/print-test-failures.sh
    - name: Upload failed tests' directories
      if: failure() && env.FAILED_TEST_ARTIFACTS != ''
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
      with:
        name: failed-tests-linux-meson
        path: ${{env.FAILED_TEST_ARTIFACTS}}
```
